recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, low-light interior scene featuring a woman standing in a shaft of warm light against a textured wall. The composition is defined by heavy shadows, a visible film grain, and a nostalgic, painterly quality created by high-contrast lighting and soft-focus optics.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject is positioned in the right third, illuminated by a vertical beam of light that creates a sharp shadow behind her.
A dark, bentwood chair in the lower left balances the figure on the right.
The typography is anchored in the upper-left corner, occupying the darkest area of the frame for maximum legibility.
coreInvariants: Warm, amber-toned highlights against deep black shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length female figure standing on the right, scaled to approximately 60% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright shaft of light hitting the subject's face and torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright text in the top left, moves down to the chair, then across to the illuminated figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive deep shadows in the lower left and upper right corners create a sense of intimacy and mystery.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and golden yellow (light shafts)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in shadows with high value contrast in the light beams; overall warm temperature.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast, condensed transitional serif with sharp terminals.
Secondary text uses a flowing, slanted formal script with connected strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning in the serif font to create a compact block of text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, vertical serif and a fluid, organic script.
graphicDevices: Thin black border framing the entire image

preserve: Golden yellow color for primary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, vertical elegance of the primary text.
Captures the formal, flowing calligraphic style of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s style analog photograph of a woman in a floral skirt standing in a dark room. A single harsh beam of warm light illuminates her from the side, casting a long shadow on the textured wall behind her. A dark wooden chair is visible in the shadows on the left. Heavy film grain, warm amber tones, soft focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top left corner. The top line should be a large, golden-yellow condensed serif font. The second line should be a medium-sized, off-white formal script font positioned closely underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text golden yellow and condensed?
Is there a visible film grain texture?
Is the subject positioned on the right side of the frame?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the golden typography
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or album title
Do not replicate the exact face of the woman
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the shadow of the woman aligns with the light source.
Check that the grain doesn't obscure the subject's features.
Confirm the color palette remains strictly warm and earthy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast interior portrait with a two-tiered typographic lockup (Condensed Serif + Script) in the upper-left quadrant, utilizing a warm, grainy analog film filter.
